```artifact
Decision Table for Battery Alarm Logic

Conditions:
1. Battery Presence (P)          : Yes / No
2. Chargeability (C)            : Chargeable / Not Chargeable
3. Battery ETA (E)              : <10 min / 10-30 min / >30 min
4. Remaining Battery Amount (R) : High / Low / Critical

Actions:
A1. Low Battery Alarm (LBA)      : Trigger / Not Trigger
A2. Critically Low Battery Alarm (CLBA) : Trigger / Not Trigger
A3. Battery Failure Alarm (BFA)  : Trigger / Not Trigger
A4. Alarm Priority (LP / HP)     : Low / High

| P   | C      | E          | R      | LBA | CLBA | BFA | Priority |
|-----|--------|------------|--------|-----|------|-----|----------|
| Yes | Chargeable | <10 min   | -      | Yes | Yes  | No  | High     |
| Yes | Chargeable | 10-30 min | -      | Yes | No    | No  | Low      |
| Yes | Chargeable | >30 min   | -      | No  | No    | No  | -        |
| Yes | Not Chargeable | -      | -      | No  | No    | Yes | -        |
| No  | -      | -          | -      | No  | No    | Yes | -        |

Notes:
- "-" denotes "don't care" (irrelevant) values.
- The "Low Battery Alarm" (LBA) is triggered when ETA < 30 min.
- The "Critically Low Battery Alarm" (CLBA) is triggered when ETA < 10 min.
- The "Battery Failure Alarm" (BFA) is triggered when battery is absent or unchargeable.
- Alarm priority is Low for LBA and High for CLBA; BFA has no priority distinction in this table.
```
